candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. Im get ear wahala. I see pus dey commot for ear. Caregiver talk say ear never discharge before. E no get pain for ear. No swelling wey dey pain for back of ear. E no get cough or wahala to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E no get fever. E no dey convulse now, and dem never see am convulse before. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E sabi drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything.
